content: Neon offers direct vs pooled (PgBouncer, -pooler hostname, transaction mode, up to 10k concurrent clients) connection strings. Serverless functions that open a new TCP connection per invocation exhaust the DIRECT endpoint's low max_connections under a traffic spike ('too many clients already') — must use the pooled connection string for any TCP-based driver. The @neondatabase/serverless driver connects over HTTP/WebSockets instead, avoiding the TCP handshake+TLS+auth round trips per cold start (~3-4 roundtrips saved), which is why it's recommended for one-shot serverless functions rather than the standard pg driver even with pooling. Connection pool exhaustion is called out as a bigger production risk than the raw query latency difference.
